runtime.description: RuntimeRef and machine identity do not exist on legacy run bindings.

BoardCursor.description:
`after = Some(id)` resumes within `rev`; None has consumed that whole revision.
The empty starting cursor is `{ rev: 0, after: None }`.

text.description: At most 60 Unicode scalar values in projector output.

attention.description: At most four unresolved attention ledger keys.

goal.description: At most 80 Unicode scalar values in projector output.

held_reason.description: Unknown for a legacy bare dispatch-hold flag.

last_event.description: Unknown until the store maintains a newest-owner-visible-event fact.

rail.description: Run, gate, review, land, in that order.

cwd.description: Raw `std::env::current_dir()`; None when unreadable or not UTF-8.

CallerEnv.description: Caller-identity variables, `None` = unset. Values are `to_string_lossy` of `var_os`.

build.description: The client's build identity (what `corral build-identity` prints).

exe.description: Absolute path of the client's executable.

message.description: The error formatted with its full context chain (`format!("{err:#}")`).

exit.description: Process exit status the CLI uses: 0 for `done`, 1 otherwise.

output.description: None for `running`, `unknown`, `abandoned`, and replays without retained output.

abandon_if_absent.description: For an absent id, write an abandoned tombstone that refuses late submits.

wait_ms.description: Wait for an in-flight command, at most 25_000.

client_build.description: Required from local CLI clients; must equal the daemon's (`pm_read::client_identity`).

oneOf.description:
A family this build does not know; its `args`, if any, are skipped. A plain
`#[serde(other)]` unit arm of an adjacently tagged enum refuses non-null content.

FileInput.description: A file named on the command line, read by the client before routing.

path.description: Path as typed (`Path::display()`), for messages only.

last_pass_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, absent before the first completed pass.

completed.description:
True only after a full pass that started after receipt of this nudge completed
within the requested wait. Finishing an already-running pass does not qualify.

OutputBody.description: Exactly `frames` DATA frames follow on `stream`: one UTF-8 JSON `CmdOutput`, `bytes` long.

oneOf.description: What clients send; the daemon replaces it from the transport.
Reserved for paired devices; refused on the Unix socket.

ReadReply.description:
The response to `read`. Exactly `frames` Data frames follow it on `stream`, carrying `bytes` bytes of
one UTF-8 JSON document, in order, with nothing else written to the connection in between.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 time the document was computed.

cached.description: True when an earlier computation was reused.

seq.description: Store change sequence the document was computed at.

build.description: The client's build identity (what `corral build-identity` prints).

exe.description: Absolute path of the client's executable.

Response.description: A response has exactly one result or error. A successful null result is preserved.

rows.description: A health page contains the single current snapshot.

oneOf.description: Pushed on topic `classic` when the daemon's frame revision passes the subscriber's cursor.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 time of the recompute that produced `rev`.

epoch.description: This daemon process's frame series; any other value means resubscribe.

rev.description: Strictly increasing within `epoch`; bumps only when frame content changed.

seq.description: Store change sequence the frame was checked through.
